attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"the Greywater Concord is watching closely","reason":"The briefing gives no Concord reaction to the Choir's inquiries."},{"span":"the archery competition has devolved into a dispute over whether the targets count as part of the event","reason":"Adds new detail to old news the briefing does not support."},{"span":"The Greywater Concord’s new speaker has yet to lower tolls or speeches","reason":"The briefing does not say whether tolls have changed."}],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"It opens with a copied heading ('News since your last bulletin:'), which breaks the no-headings rule. It also invents developments: the Concord watching, a new archery dispute, and the state of the tolls. Two of its three items recycle old news as ongoing stories instead of brief background."}
